I took my dog ​​Penny for an oncology appointment in January.
We began a course of chemotherapy with Dr. Pellegrino to treat Penny's lymphoma; over the past six months, she has responded well to the treatment, and now, about a month ago, we've been on maintenance therapy.
I'm incredibly satisfied with the professionalism I've received.
Caring and professional, so grateful to them

Hello, I'm here to warn all pet owners to avoid this veterinarian regarding the services of oncologist Vito Pellegrino, who collaborates here. My case is as follows: I took my 10-year-old Yorkshire Terrier to review a histology report from a bladder cystoscopy, which revealed a probable carcinoma. Mr. Vito Pellegrino's diagnosis was that the dog is inoperable. The only option was chemotherapy, costing approximately €1,800, which would allow me to hope for an extra year of life for my dog. The entire process was described to me in an inhumane manner, with zero empathy and a smirk plastered across my face. Obviously, at that moment, I was desperate and unable to react, so I had the dog undergo his first chemotherapy session for €310, with no invoice; otherwise, the cost would have been €390. The chemotherapy administered by the mysterious oncologist Vito Pellegrino lasted only 10 minutes, and I was asked to leave the room.
Of course, when I got home, I rethought the whole process. Four days later, I went to another specialist for a different opinion. The second specialist's diagnosis was completely different, both in terms of the approach and, above all, in terms of what to do to resolve the problem. The dog underwent surgery for bladder cancer. The histology confirmed the tumor and showed no contaminated edges or metastases, so everything went well. Furthermore, I was reminded that a chemotherapy session injected intravenously cannot last less than 30 minutes and is impossible to administer in just 10 minutes.
In light of this whole story, I strongly advise against trusting this dishonest and incompetent person named Vito Pellegrino, who also prescribed me medications by incorrectly filling out the prescription to pick them up at the pharmacy.
Exceptional medical staff
kind and efficient
visiting from the U.S., these guys definitely earned my trust and respect. Would 100% go to them with any needs or concerns relating to my dog
He's been our trusted vet for years now. All the doctors are friendly, helpful, and explain things clearly: thorough and attentive to our needs and those of our four-legged friends.

I was on a trip in Roma with my dog. He injured himself, I was in panic! But fortunatly i found this clinic where I had a great experience! Doctors were amazing and the nurse Marianne was very kind and professional ! Thank you so much!
Always very helpful and welcoming! Professional and loving towards our furry friends.

I went to Dr. Paini with my diabetic cat, who had been treated with diet alone for a year. I had lost faith in my vet and decided to go to Dr. Paini, recommended by the Diabetes Vet Academy in Bologna. The visit was very thorough, lasting an hour and a half. He handled Cleo perfectly, who was terrified, reassured me, and even complimented me on my knowledge of diabetes! I highly recommend him.
They were very welcoming and helpful with us and especially with our friends, Bau Miao...😺🐺 …

If you're looking for a good oncologist, trust Dr. Pellegrino's care. He's been treating my Raul, who has lymphoma, for almost a year. He's been the only one who hasn't made me anxious and taken away my fears about chemotherapy treatments. Without him, my dog ​​would have been gone for a while now. Obviously, chemo doesn't work miracles, but it certainly gives him many moments of life lived well. ♥️
Really great experience. Extremely kind and gentle veterinarian who did a thorough check of my maltese and gave great advice. Highly recommend to others.
Kind and professional

I took my Lola to Dr. Benvenuti for a checkup. She saved my dog ​​from a nasty case of enteritis. The staff was kind and helpful, the doctor was very professional and well-trained, and the environment was very clean.
This was my first time at the office. I was pleasantly surprised by the thoroughness, professionalism, and time spent examining my cat, who has heart disease. Congratulations!
Super professional, serious and attentive.

I  recommend Veterinaria Trastevere. Beyond the excellent medical standards, what truly sets this place apart is the incredible humanity of the staff. They understand that behind every patient there is a family, and they handled our situation with rare sensitivity—finding ways to truly help and support us, even within the context of private medical assistance.

A huge compliment to the entire team, but a special mention must go to the male veterinary nurse. You can immediately tell he is highly specialized and skilled, but more importantly, he does this job with true passion and dedication. Thank you all for everything.

In a veterinary clinic, technical expertise is not enough if empathy, listening, and respect are lacking.

The way we were treated in a moment of extreme pain was inhumane: no sensitivity, no time to understand or process, no attention paid to the words used in front of emotionally devastated people.
It is unacceptable to allow allusions to a supposed lack of care for our animals or insinuations that we were not present.
We cannot afford to speak this way to someone who, in the space of a few days, said final goodbye to their two cats, whom they loved unconditionally.
The lack of tact and humanity was total and unacceptable.

UPDATE

Following your response, I would like to clarify that NEVER HAS ANY CARE BEEN DISREGARDED, NEVER HAS ANY OF OUR ANIMALS BEEN DEPRIVED OF OUR LOVE.
Therefore, please refrain from any judgment on our decisions and actions, which, of course, were NEVER MADE to cause our beloved Sergio suffering.
Please refrain from judging what pet owners decide to do at such a delicate time. We decided to give Sergio all the love we could in his final days, NEVER leaving him alone. We supported him step by step, through ALL stages of his illness. If you aren't with us 24/7 and don't have the information to judge, in your place, I would simply remain silent.

MORE:
We didn't bring Sergio "closed and ready for cremation." He was in his carrier, covered with a towel to preserve the dignity every animal deserves, especially at such a delicate stage.

Who do you think you're dealing with?
But then, "you've ignored the advice over these years," but which years? Sergio's diabetes was diagnosed in May 2025. How dare you write such things and make such accusations? What do you know? Doctors' advice was ALWAYS followed, and Sergio was treated and cared for with all the love in the world.
Nothing more needs to be said; you speak for yourself.
How embarrassing...

In moments of fragility, when we expect professionalism but also a modicum of human empathy, we found ourselves faced with a cold, judgmental, and insensitive attitude.
With the second cat dying in three days, doctors hastily and arrogantly alluding to mistreatment by those who have lovingly cared for them for years. Doctors insistently demanding an immediate decision on whether to put them down, without even giving the family time to discuss it.

No understanding, no listening, no support. Just haste and detachment.

An approach that to call inadequate is an understatement. We will not return and we will not recommend you to anyone.

UPDATE:
Our review is not born from an "emotional wave" (as you cowardly would have us believe), but from a specific fact and specific words spoken in a moment of enormous pain.
It is unacceptable that, instead of showing humanity and respect, you alluded to abuse, chose to rush her with harsh words, "why did you have to close?", used phrases like "it's not the first time it's happened," and alluded to alleged lapses in the cat's care. This is what we call unspeakable and SHAMEFUL behavior.

An animal's suffering does not justify a total lack of empathy for those accompanying it in its final moments. The problem was not having to make a difficult decision, but the way it was made.
It is sad to see that even in this response, you continue to cast blame, instead of examining how certain words and tones can deeply hurt. I invite the kind nurse to examine her conscience and probably consider whether this is the job for her.

We would have liked to be able to document what happened, so that others could fully appreciate the level of humanity found in this place.

Shameful, to the end.

I would like to know when and how the therapeutic recommendations for Sergio were allegedly disregarded, before and after his two hospitalizations at the clinic you recommended, and during subsequent check-ups. I remind you that, at the last visit to your clinic, given his stress and agitation, you were unable to perform a complete weight-bearing curve. You suggested not bringing him into the office for subsequent check-ups to avoid overstressing him (he was 'unmanageable,' remember?). You also provided me with the number of a private nurse who could perform the check-ups at my home. At that point, I dusted off my old university knowledge and personally checked Sergio's blood sugar every day... there were some fluctuations, but with the affection due to a member of the family, everything was managed satisfactorily and without trauma, until, unexpectedly, a third hospitalization became necessary in November (via the emergency room), a hospitalization that restored the situation... but then, on December 31st, the other house cat died suddenly, Sergio stopped eating, making it impossible to continue his insulin therapy. We decided, at that point, that the situation required a precise choice: given that the parameters would return, unfortunately only temporarily, we decided to prioritize the quality of his final days of life.

I owed you that much.
Mariella Dante
Dante
Good center. Friendly staff.

There aren't enough words to thank this clinic, especially Dr. Vito Pellegrino and Dr. Elisa Corsi, but truly the entire team.

I came to them when I had almost given up hope, with a dog suffering from lymphoma, after consulting very well-known oncologists who were too focused on payments and too little on my dog. Dr. Pellegrino, in just a few minutes, explained to me what others had failed to do, and we immediately began a treatment that gave us another year of happy, high-quality life, despite the disease.

After a year, as I had been told from the beginning, the time came when we had to let her go, when she was still doing well but the disease was now very advanced and the risk of suffering was imminent.

I have no words to thank Vito and Elisa for the empathy, professionalism, and sensitivity they showed throughout the entire journey, up to the last moment and even after.

Thank you to the entire team. Thanks to you, my little Eli had a wonderful life and left us only when there was no choice, loved and with a belly full of sausages.

The entrance is really awkward. Narrow. At the entrance, they wouldn't let us in despite the rain because they open at 10. There were 3 people comfortably seated inside!!! I paid 95 euros for a 15-minute visit. The vet touched the cat and felt the lymph nodes. For the rest, I was the only one who spoke. To get explanations already given by my vet. I don't think I'll go back.
Excellent facility, I finally found everything I was looking for for my cat. Special thanks to Dr. Alessandro 😺 …
Optimal

I wholeheartedly recommend Veteraria Trastevere.
Today I came with my dog ​​Kappa and was treated by Alessandro with rare professionalism, but above all with great humanity.

The first thing that struck me was that Alessandro didn't immediately go for a "technical" examination, but started with the right questions: he asked about his daily life, his environment, his personality, and the situation we had experienced. You could tell he really wanted to get to know the animal, not just the "case."

Kappa is a very fearful dog and usually doesn't let anyone touch him... but here he trusted me. The atmosphere was calm, respectful, and sweet. Alessandro examined Kappa calmly, sensitively, and with great empathy, and that made all the difference.

The thing that confirmed to me that I was in the right place was his final sentence:

"I do this job with all my heart."

And that's exactly what it is.

This is why I happily travel from Anzio to Rome: because here, animals are seen, listened to, and treated with love, as well as expertise.

A heartfelt thank you to Alessandro and the entire team at Veterinaria Trastevere. ❤️🐾
Very friendly and professional service. The staff speaks good English.
Excellent professionals, I sincerely thank Dr. Ilaria and Dr. Paini for taking care of my beloved iron dog with great passion and professionalism. I will never forget you.
To say they're great is an understatement. A great team, so much expertise, so much professionalism 🐾 …
Excellent and very kind

I come to this veterinary practice to get Solensia shots for my elderly cat. The practice is highly professional in keeping track of the cat's health (he is weighed and analyzed, and I receive email updates every time, and I have a history of his health). I value the balance between care and treatment for animal well-being, combined with great humanity and a lack of aggressive treatment (which often happens in clinics that exploit affection for the sole purpose of extorting money from their owners). This aspect is very important to me because I had a terrible experience with a clinic in the past that ended tragically, and being able to count on professionals of this caliber makes me feel more confident and supported in the best possible way to care for my cat.
Marvelous!!!
Good prices. Our doctor was super friendly and knowledgeable.
Professionalism, empathy, and great honesty...the best veterinary center in Rome.

I am especially grateful to Dr. Erika Romano, whose extensive training and experience, combined with her determination to address and resolve her patients' issues in the best possible way, has been a constant source of support for me at this clinic.

Competent, extremely attentive and scrupulous, and very kind. True professionals who truly love animals!!!
